## Why visit

A strong modern addition to Stockport’s exceptional traditional-pub circuit. The taproom occupies a former metalworks, with the brewery visible beside the bar, communal tables and a courtyard setting. Cask is genuinely part of the offer, while the keg and bottled range lets you compare formats from the same producer. It is particularly convenient near the bus interchange and the Crown/viaduct side of town, so it need not consume a separate travel day. Add it when you want production context and pizza alongside the old pubs; a brewery tour remains a separately checked activity.

## Beer

The operator advertises two casks and ten keg lines each week, plus bottled beer; current choices vary.

## Cider and perry

**Real cider documented; reconfirm stock.** CAMRA explicitly lists real cider in bottles/cans, with Thornborough and Ascension examples. Ask which products are currently stocked.

See [how cider is classified](../real-cider.md).

## Food

CAMRA documents Honest Crust pizza; verify the current vendor and kitchen schedule before relying on it.

## Plan the visit

Official taproom days are Thursday–Sunday; shop hours differ. Card only and no table reservations. Use Stockport, not the former Manchester location.

**Getting there:** Near Stockport bus interchange and walkable from Stockport station; close to the Crown Inn.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
